globaltix_product_data.name: VinWonders Phu Quoc
globaltix_product_data.summary: VinWonders Phu Quoc is Vietnam’s largest theme park and one of the top entertainment destinations on Phu Quoc Island, offering a full-day experience for visitors of all ages. Spanning nearly 50 hectares, the park combines world-class rides, immersive themed zones, live entertainment, and family-frie...
globaltix_product_data.description: VinWonders Phu Quoc is Vietnam’s largest theme park and one of the top entertainment destinations on Phu Quoc Island, offering a full-day experience for visitors of all ages. Spanning nearly 50 hectares, the park combines world-class rides, immersive themed zones, live entertainment, and family-friendly attractions in one vibrant destination. Designed around six unique themed worlds, VinWonders takes visitors on a journey through fantasy, adventure, and cultural storytelling. From fairytale-inspired castles and European streets to mysterious ancient civilizations and Viking-themed adventures, each zone offers its own atmosphere and attractions. Guests can enjoy a wide range of experiences, including roller coasters, interactive games, water slides, indoor attractions, and one of Vietnam’s largest aquariums. A major highlight is the Sea Shell Aquarium, a striking sea turtle-shaped landmark that houses thousands of marine species, interactive exhibits, and captivating underwater displays. Thrill seekers can explore high-speed rides and adventure attractions, while families with children can enjoy gentler rides, themed playgrounds, and educational experiences. In the evening, the park comes alive with dazzling performances, including the signature Once show featuring music, lighting effects, and storytelling. Located in the Grand World area in northern Phu Quoc, VinWonders is an ideal destination for families, couples, and groups looking to combine entertainment, sightseeing, and unique experiences. Whether you're seeking adrenaline-pumping rides, memorable family moments, or immersive themed attractions, VinWonders Phu Quoc offers one of the most complete theme park experiences in Vietnam.
highlights: Explore six themed worlds – Discover diverse zones inspired by fairy tales, Viking adventures, ancient civilizations and more.
Visit the iconic Sea Shell Aquarium – Experience one of Vietnam’s largest aquariums, home to thousands of marine species in a striking turtle-shaped building.
Enjoy thrilling rides and attractions – From roller coasters and drop towers to family rides and interactive indoor games, there’s something for every age.
Cool off at the water park – Splash into one of Southeast Asia’s largest water parks, featuring exciting slides, wave pools, and fun zones for kids.
Watch spectacular live shows – End your day with colorful performances, including the signature evening show with music, lights, and immersive storytelling.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Visit Busan Pass is an all-in-one tourist pass that provides travelers with convenient, cash-free access to Busan's top attractions, transportation options, and exclusive discounts. Designed to simplify your trip, the pass grants entry to popular sites such as observatories, museums, cultural experiences, cruises, and theme parks—all while helping you save money and skip ticket lines. It’s an ideal choice for first-time and returning visitors who want to explore Busan with ease and maximize their travel experience.
highlights: Unlimited access to major Busan attractions with one pass.
Fast, convenient entry without the hassle of buying individual tickets.
Exclusive discounts for tours, shopping, and experiences across the city.

globaltix_product_data.description: Step into the stunning world of Wai-O-Tapu Thermal Wonderland, a must-see destination in Rotorua, New Zealand. This geothermal park showcases some of the most striking natural features in the country, including the world-famous Champagne Pool, vibrant hot springs, volcanic craters, and the largest Sinter Terrace in the Southern Hemisphere. Explore 26 unique natural wonders as you walk through this vibrant landscape, and witness the daily eruption of the Lady Knox Geyser. With easy access and just 1.5 hours to cover the entire park, Wai-O-Tapu offers an unforgettable experience of volcanic activity and colorful pools. Pre-purchase your ticket for express entry to make the most of your visit!

globaltix_product_data.summary: Waterbom Bali is the island’s premier waterpark, which has over a dozen exciting waterslides and water games for all ages. globaltix_product_data.description: Waterbom Bali is the island’s premier waterpark, which has over a dozen exciting waterslides and water games for all ages. The park covers 38,000 sq m of tropical gardens and pools, as well as onsite dining and leisure facilities. Rides at the waterpark include leisurely pools with mini slides and adrenaline-pumping rides that start from significant heights. Rides for thrill-seekers include 'Fast n' Fierce' and ‘Twin Racers’ where you can challenge your partner for a splashing race down. Some of the rides require specially designed tubes with grips to hold onto.
highlights: Waterbom Bali stands out as the island's top waterpark destination
Spanning across 38,000 square meters of tropical gardens and pools
From leisurely pools with mini slides to heart-pounding rides starting from significant heights
Thrill-seekers can indulge in exhilarating rides such as 'Fast n' Fierce' and ‘Twin Racers
For added safety and enjoyment, some rides require specially designed tubes with grips
inclusions: Non Refundable In Park credit IDR 500,000
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission Ticket is valid on the visit date. Re-entry to the venue is permitted. Show your ticket, wristband, or stamp upon re-entry at the entrance. Admission is at your own risk. Waterbom Bali is not responsible for any injuries or lost or stolen items, even if assistance is provided. Eligibility Children must be aged between 2 – 11 years old. Attraction Access Includes access to the entire park and all slides during operating hours. Additional Information All reschedule requests are subject to Waterbom Bali’s approval. F&B, towel hire, lockers, Euro Bungy, FlowRider, photos, and gazebo rental are charged separately. Locker and towel rentals are available on-site. Muslim-friendly dining is available at Wantilan Food Court (Pork-Free Zone) offering Indonesian, Asian, Western, Italian, Mediterranean, and Middle Eastern cuisine. No outside food or drinks allowed. No pets are permitted. Important Notes What to bring: Comfortable swimwear and extra clothes. Secure your valuables. Waterbom Bali is not liable for lost or stolen items. Waterslides are not recommended for guests with chronic health issues, recent surgery, pregnancy, or severe back or heart conditions. Prohibited items on waterslides include jewelry, metal-decorated clothing, cut-off jeans, and glasses. How to Get There By Car: We recommend taking a taxi directly to Waterbom for the most convenient journey.
globaltix_product_data.address: Jl. Kartika Plaza Tuban Kuta

After pickup from your accommodation (based on selected zones), guests are transported directly to the park entrance. Upon arrival, participants can proceed with ticket validation and enter the park at their own pace. This setup allows for a structured yet flexible experience without the need for separate transport arrangements.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Westminster Abbey situated on the north bank of the River Thames in London, next to the Houses of Parliament, is a magnificent Royal Catholic Cathedral in the Gothic style, a holy place in England, and prominent among the many churches in the country. globaltix_product_data.description: Westminster Abbey situated on the north bank of the River Thames in London, next to the Houses of Parliament, is a magnificent Royal Catholic Cathedral in the Gothic style, a holy place in England, and prominent among the many churches in the country. The coronation throne of Edward I is located behind the church altar. This dilapidated seat has witnessed the changes of the British royal family for hundreds of years.
highlights: Explore the magnificent, solemn, and quiet representative of Gothic architecture, and experience the thousand-year history of the majestic church
Stroll through the British State Burial Mausoleum and visit the resting places of royal family members and legendary figures such as Newton, Darwin, and Churchi
Visit the place on the north bank of the Thames where kings were crowned and royal family members held weddings

Join a Top Blue Badge Guide on the best walking tour of Central London

globaltix_product_data.name: Willowbank Wildlife Reserve Tickets
globaltix_product_data.summary: Buy your tickets online to Christchurch's favourite animal park, Willowbank Wildlife Reserve, and see all of New Zealand's best animals up close! Boasting one of the widest arrays of native NZ wildlife in the country, Willowbank Wildlife Reserve offers visitors an in-depth look at these delicate and...
globaltix_product_data.description: Buy your tickets online to Christchurch's favourite animal park, Willowbank Wildlife Reserve, and see all of New Zealand's best animals up close! Boasting one of the widest arrays of native NZ wildlife in the country, Willowbank Wildlife Reserve offers visitors an in-depth look at these delicate and cute creatures in their natural environments - many of which are true New Zealand icons such as Kea, Tuatara, and, of course, Kiwi birds. Ideal for adults and families alike, at Willowbank Reserve you'll be able to make your own way around the park in a pleasant environment that gives the animals freedom and allows you to feed them right out of your hand! In addition to the NZ animals, see creatures from all over the globe including monkeys, lemurs, llamas and much more. Located in a spot that gives great views over Christchurch and its lovely surrounds, home to friendly, passionate staff who are always willing to provide help and insight into the behaviours of the animals, and set out over an expansive, 7 hectare area full of the rare and the exotic from both NZ and abroad, Willowbank Wildlife Reserve is one of the Christchurch region's true "must-do's". If you're after a full day of animal entertainment, grab your tickets to Willowbank Reserve here today! Inclusions * General admission to Willowbank Wildlife Reserve * View the New Zealand's ‘Big 5’ the kiwi, the bush parrot the kākā, the ancient tuatara, cheeky kea and very rare takahē * Visit New Zealand’s ‘Rare Breed’ farm animals, with the background depicting the colonial agriculture of New Zealand early farming years * Meet the giant Clydesdale, Miniature Horses, rare breeds of Goats and Sheep, the famous Kune Kune Pigs, the rare Auckland Island Pigs, Llamas, Cattle and much more * Get a ‘hands on’ experience and is always popular with visitors with Deer, Wallabies, Otters, Lemurs and Gibbons Extras * 45 Minute guided tour of the New Zealand area which displays many NZ birds and animals. We guarantee you will see a Kiwi, often in very close proximity * Animal and bird food is sold at the front counter for the opportunity to feed certain animals in the designated feeding area Booking Information * Confirmation in the form of a tour voucher will be received at time of booking * Upon completion of purchase, please print the voucher and present on day of the experience * Vouchers can also be presented on your mobile device for this attraction * Availability was accurate at the time of booking however, is subject to change due to circumstances out of our control * For your information, complete Tour Operator Information including contact details is included on your tour voucher * We strongly suggest reconfirming your booking with the tour operator within 24 hours of making your booking and prior to making other travel arrangements

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: 1, The film experience begins at the time listed on your ticket. Late seating is not permitted. 2, Doors open 30 minutes before the time listed on your ticket. Late seating is not permitted. 3, The Wizard of Oz at Sphere is intended for guests aged 6+. All guests, regardless of age, require a ticket. 4, The Wizard of Oz at Sphere is an immersive experience with various elements, including seat haptics, movement sensations, flashing lights, intense lighting, visual effects, loud noises, falling and flying objects, projectiles, pyrotechnics and atmospheric simulations such as fog, wind, bubbles, mist and scent. Such elements may aggravate certain medical or physical conditions, and guests should take into consideration if they have a history of discomfort or physical symptoms when experiencing these elements. If you have any concerns and/or are pregnant, you should consult with your physician prior to attending an immersive experience. 5, Photo and video may be taken throughout the Atrium but are not permitted during the film experience. 6, Free WiFi is available at Sphere. Guests can connect to “Free Sphere WiFi” once onsite. 7, All ticket sales are final – no refunds or exchanges. 8, The FAQs: https://www.thesphere.com/faqs 9, Your assigned seats may not be consecutive.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Discover the story behind the world's most iconic beverage at this beloved Atlanta attraction. globaltix_product_data.description: Discover the story behind the world's most iconic beverage at this beloved Atlanta attraction. Located in Pemberton Place right next to the Georgia Aquarium, the World of Coca-Cola brings over 135 years of brand history to life across 11 interactive exhibition areas. From the legendary secret formula to a global tasting experience, it is a fun and immersive stop for soda lovers, history buffs, and families alike. The Coca-Cola Museum is located in Atlanta's Pemberton Square, adjacent to the Georgia State Aquarium, which opened in November 2005. The land on which the aquarium is located was also donated by The Coca-Cola Company. In addition, Coca-Cola donated more than 10,000 square meters of land to the Atlanta local department for the construction of the Civil Rights Museum. Pemberton Square is within walking distance of many attractions, including Central Olympic Park, making it easy for tourists to visit. The Coca-Cola Museum is a collection and reproduction of the infinite charm of Coca-Cola. It not only depicts the present of the Coca-Cola Company, but also depicts the infinite vision of the Coca-Cola Company for the future. Among them, more than 1,000 kinds of Coca-Cola handicrafts are exhibited to meet the world. The building strictly adheres to the U.S. Green Building Council's energy-efficient and environmentally friendly design standards and is one of the few green buildings in Georgia.
highlights: Get up close to the vault that supposedly holds Coca-Cola's legendary secret recipe, with exhibits exploring the history (and mystery)
The crowd favorite where you can sample more than 100 different Coca-Cola beverages from around the world
A newer immersive exhibit (opened 2025) where you walk through an immersive Coca-Cola town featuring an old-school pharmacy
A reimagined sensory exhibit that lets guests explore the aromas that give Coca-Cola products their flavors, connecting smell and taste.
Meet and snap a photo with the beloved mascot, located in the Icons exhibit,

globaltix_product_data.summary: Spot koalas, kangaroos, manatees, giant pandas, and over 6,000 other animals in France's number one zoo. globaltix_product_data.description: Spot koalas, kangaroos, manatees, giant pandas, and over 6,000 other animals in France's number one zoo. With excellent shows and entertainment for kids – plus pandas so fascinating you could stop and stare for hours – this dose of animal magic is a guaranteed awesome family day out. Explore the tropics inside a massive 12,000m² equatorial dome with manatees, Komodo dragons, and more. See the animals of South America, Asia, and Africa, and enjoy a 360° view of the dome from up high. ZooParc de Beauval is the only zoo in France with giant pandas. But that's not all: it's home to the largest diversity of animals in the whole country (over 6,000 of our furry and scaly friends live here)! Take your time and catch some shows. Les Maîtres des Airs sees 200 birds flying over your heads (you may want to wear a hat), while L’Odyssée des Lions de Mer features a bunch of friendly sea lions showing off for you. Head to the hippopotamus reserve, spot Simba and pals in La terre des lions, and new in the park, see pandas, Arctic wolves, and cheetahs. And it's not just the extensive range of species, the zoo is dedicated to conservation and the habitats are wide-open, with energetic animals making full use of the space. It's fuzzy, four-legged edutainment at its finest, and if the animals could speak, they'd speak in French. What's not to love?

Expect good times at the number one zoo in France, plus the cutest pandas

globaltix_product_data.name: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
globaltix_product_data.summary: The Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding, located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, is a world-renowned conservation and research center dedicated to protecting and breeding giant pandas. Known as the “panda capital of the world,” it provides a natural habitat for these rare animals, with bambo...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding, located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, is a world-renowned conservation and research center dedicated to protecting and breeding giant pandas. Known as the “panda capital of the world,” it provides a natural habitat for these rare animals, with bamboo forests, lakes, and lush vegetation. Visitors can observe giant pandas of all ages, from playful cubs in the nursery to adult pandas in open enclosures, as well as the smaller and equally charming red pandas. The base also features educational exhibits about panda conservation, breeding programs, and efforts to protect endangered wildlife. With well-designed walking paths, bamboo groves, and observation areas, the center offers an immersive experience where travelers can learn about panda ecology while enjoying close-up encounters with China’s national treasure. Morning visits are especially recommended, as pandas are most active during feeding times.
highlights: Visit the nursery to watch playful baby pandas cared for by keepers.
Explore bamboo groves, lakes, and gardens designed to mimic wild environments.
Learn about panda breeding, research, and wildlife protection through exhibits and displays.
Home to the largest giant panda breeding and conservation center.
Meet the equally adorable red pandas living alongside giant pandas.
